The '''Mk. III Stygium Cloaking Device''' was a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and used a crystal called [[Stygium crystal|Stygium]]. The device is capable of cloaking the ship by removing the ship's presence from radar. The little that the device did leak the ship hull came up as mild interference. The device also slightly visibly cloaked the ship from what can be seen in the images of the ship.
